from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('captures',type=Path,nargs='+')
parser.add_argument('--probe',type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--baseline',type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
parser.add_argument('--runs',type=int,default=5)
args=parser.parse_args();target=Path('target').resolve();out=args.out.resolve()
assert out.is_relative_to(target) and args.runs>0
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
probes={'rust':args.probe.resolve(),'baseline':args.baseline.resolve()}
record={'scope':'Fresh native processes and identical physical copies; full frozen Python dumps checked on every operation. Original Python-generated DML floor is prepared and replayed in a fresh candidate process. Rendering/copies/dump checks outside CPU timer.','script':Path(__file__).read_text(),'probes':{n:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n,p in probes.items()},'cells':[]}
for capture in args.captures:
 assert capture.resolve().is_relative_to(target)
 dest=out/capture.name;dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True);runtime=dest/'runtime'
 request=json.loads((capture/'request.json').read_text());assert isinstance(request.get('expected'),dict)
 request['database']=str(runtime/'kassiber.sqlite3')
 request_file=dest/'request.json';request_file.write_text(json.dumps(request,separators=(',',':')))
 floor=json.loads((capture/'floor.json').read_text());assert isinstance(floor.get('expected'),dict)
 floor['database']=request['database'];floor_file=dest/'floor.json';floor_file.write_text(json.dumps(floor,separators=(',',':')))
 trials=[]
 for run in range(args.runs):
  pair={}
  for name in (['rust','baseline','floor'] if run%2==0 else ['baseline','rust','floor']):
   if runtime.exists():shutil.rmtree(runtime)
   shutil.copytree(capture/'base',runtime)
   load=os.getloadavg();probe=probes['rust' if name=='floor' else name]
   process=subprocess.run([str(probe)],input=str(floor_file if name=='floor' else request_file)+'\n',capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
   result=json.loads(process.stdout)
   assert result['ok'],(capture.name,name,result)
   pair[name]={'cpu_seconds':result['cpu_seconds'],'seconds':result['seconds'],'phases':result.get('phases'),'loadavg':load}
  trials.append(pair);print(capture.name,run,{n:t['cpu_seconds'] for n,t in pair.items()},flush=True)
  cell={'capture':str(capture),'capture_hashes':{str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [capture/'request.json',capture/'floor.json',capture/'base/kassiber.sqlite3']},'trials':trials,'best':{n:min(t[n]['cpu_seconds'] for t in trials) for n in ('rust','baseline','floor')}}
  (dest/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(cell,indent=2)+'\n')
 record['cells'].append(cell);(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
 shutil.rmtree(runtime)
